allow_instructions: Allow git status, git diff, git log, git show, git branch, and git rev-parse operations.
Allow local linting, typechecking, tests, builds, and formatting.
Allow pnpm commands that operate on the local project and its dependency installation.
Allow creating and editing files inside the current repository as part of the active implementation task.
Allow starting and stopping disposable local development servers and disposable local test databases.
Allow local Git commits after verification when they do not push or rewrite remote history.
block_instructions: Require approval for git push, force push, remote branch deletion, merge to main, tags, or releases.
Require approval before any production deployment.
Require approval for AWS, Vercel, Netlify, Railway, Render, Google Cloud, or other cloud commands that mutate remote infrastructure.
Require approval for production database migrations, resets, schema pushes, deletes, or data mutations.
Require approval before commands that print or inspect the contents of .env files, github.authkey, private keys, service-account keys, tokens, credentials, or secret files.
Require approval before modifying DNS, payment providers, OAuth provider settings, WhatsApp Meta configuration, billing, or external account configuration.
Require approval for destructive filesystem operations outside disposable build artifacts or temporary test directories.
